name: Introduction of the European Health Insurance Card in Croatia
notes: Also HRV-EU-2012-001-0005 (preparations reaching completion), HRV-GOV-2014-001-0002, -0003 (issuing figures 2013) and -0006 (use by EU visitors after accession). Croatian name Europska kartica zdravstvenog osiguranja (EKZO). Analogue of INT-MDA-0410 and INT-MKD-0197. Issue RI-FMW-015.

name: Regulation on the European Health Insurance Card (December 2011)
notes: Adopted December 2011 (month stated); sets validity, separate card form and issuing details. Issuing body and Croatian title not stated in the source. Issue RI-FMW-015.

name: Central health information system of primary health care (CEZIH)
notes: Centralni informacijski sustav primarne zdravstvene zaštite. Also HRV-GOV-2013-002-0003 (planned 2013 upgrade) and HRV-GOV-2014-001-0005 (public key infrastructure). Analogue of INT-MDA-0398 (integrated health information system). Issue RI-FMW-015.

name: Central information system of the Croatian Health Insurance Fund (HZZO)
notes: Centralni informacijski sustav HZZO-a; hardware migration with CEZIH due May 2013. Also HRV-GOV-2013-002-0004 (planned 2013 upgrade). Issue RI-FMW-015.

name: Consolidation of all registers in the health system
notes: Objedinjavanje svih registara u zdravstvenom sustavu; tender launched in 2012 under the IT component of a World Bank project. Issue RI-FMW-015.

name: Procedure for issuing European Health Insurance Cards to officials of the foreign and defence ministries
notes: Agreed by HZZO with the Ministry of Foreign and European Affairs and the Ministry of Defence in 2013; whether before or after accession is not stated. Could instead be recorded as an alternative name under the Croatian EHIC introduction record. Issue RI-FMW-015.

name: Agreements on the use of the European Health Insurance Card with nine EU Member States
notes: Also SRB-EU-2025-001-0015 and SRB-EU-2026-001-0003 (unchanged at nine). Member States not named. For Serbia's own country model this belongs to RI-FMW-011, as INT-MKD-0198 for North Macedonia; recorded against RI-FMW-015 under LIM-0048.
